criteria.justification: NexaWorks presents a modular architecture (NexaPlatform) deployed across primary AWS and DR Azure environments. The technical specifications exceed the RFP benchmarks for throughput (25,000 TPS vs 10,000 TPS required), latency (<130 ms), RPO (≤ 10 min), RTO (≤ 30 min), and concurrent users (3,000).
criteria.evidence: NexaWorks proposes the NexaPlatform — our configurable enterprise integration and workflow engine deployed on AWS (ap-southeast-1, primary) and Azure (Southeast Asia, DR)... API Throughput: 25,000 TPS (2.5× headroom)... P95 API Latency: < 130 ms... RPO ≤ 10 min (async replication)... RTO ≤ 30 min automated failover.

criteria.justification: The proposal details a clear 15-week, 4-phase delivery model (Discovery, Build, Testing, Go-Live) governed by the hybrid NexaDeliver methodology. A 13-person dedicated team is identified with key Singapore-based leads, clear exit gates, and regular risk reviews.
criteria.evidence: NexaWorks uses the NexaDeliver methodology — a structured hybrid (Agile + PRINCE2 governance). Two parallel workstreams run simultaneously... A 13-person dedicated team is proposed, with Singapore-based client-facing leads and Kuala Lumpur delivery team... Governance: Fortnightly risk review.

criteria.justification: Commercial terms are transparently itemized with fixed-fee services, Year 1 SaaS licensing, annual support, and milestone-based payments totaling SGD 685,000 (excl. GST and AWS). Key operational assumptions and exclusions are clearly stated.
criteria.evidence: Sub-Total (Implementation): 615,000... TOTAL YEAR 1 (excl. GST, excl. AWS): 685,000... Payment milestones: 25% on contract award | 35% Phase completion (Build) | 25% UAT sign-off | 15% go-live.

criteria.justification: Security standards are explicitly defined, referencing ISO 27001:2022 certification, MAS TRM alignment, PDPA impact assessment, AES-256 encryption, bi-annual VAPT, and 24/7 P1 incident response timelines.
criteria.evidence: Certifications: ISO 27001:2022 | ISO 9001:2015... AES-256 at rest; TLS 1.3 in transit... MAS TRM gap assessment + remediation; PDPA impact assessment... Incident Response: Documented IRP; 1-hour P1 notification; post-incident review within 5 days.

criteria.justification: NexaWorks provides a comprehensive 24x7 support matrix with aggressive SLAs (30-min P1 response / 4-hr resolution), a named Singapore-based Customer Success Lead, post-go-live hypercare, and strong reference projects across relevant enterprise sectors.
criteria.evidence: P1 – Critical: 30 min response, 4 hours resolution (24x7)... Named Customer Success Lead: Ms. Nadira Osman (Singapore)... Relevant Experience: Petronas Retail (SGD 3.2M), DBS Fintech Unit (SGD 2.8M), Sunway Group (SGD 2.1M), Grab Logistics (SGD 1.6M).

risks: Schedule risk dependent on client completing AWS account provisioning within 1 week of contract award.
Integration timeline relies on client providing access to existing ERP and HR APIs within 2 weeks of kick-off.
Data migration scope is strictly limited to live production data, excluding historical archives older than 5 years.
suppliers.overall_summary: NexaWorks submits an exceptionally thorough and high-quality response, backed by relevant enterprise reference cases, solid security compliance (MAS TRM and ISO 27001), and a modular architecture exceeding technical expectations. Implementation and commercial structures are well-defined, though project delivery relies on early client setup and API access.

criteria.justification: Apex Systems details an exceptional cloud-native micro-services architecture spanning multi-cloud AWS and Azure environments. Their technical benchmarks significantly exceed requirements, providing 5.5x headroom for API throughput along with aggressive RPO/RTO targets.
criteria.evidence: Our solution follows a cloud-native micro-services architecture deployed on AWS (primary) with Azure as the cross-region DR target... API Throughput Target (RFP): 10,000 TPS, Apex Design Capacity: 55,000 TPS (5.5× headroom)... RPO ≤ 5 min (continuous replication), RTO ≤ 18 min automated failover.

criteria.justification: The implementation plan is thoroughly structured over 18 months using SAFe 6.0 Agile-at-Scale. It includes explicit phase deliverables, client-witnessed exit criteria, a detailed top-8 risk mitigation matrix, and a dedicated 34-person team with well-defined roles and credentials.
criteria.evidence: The programme is structured across four phases spanning 18 months using SAFe 6.0 Agile-at-Scale. Each phase concludes with a client-witnessed acceptance gate... Dedicated 34-person team will be exclusively allocated to EDIM... Risk Register — Top 8.

criteria.justification: The commercial proposal offers high transparency with itemized fixed-fee pricing across phases, clear payment milestones tied to deliverables, explicit inclusion of a 5% contingency reserve, and clear pass-through estimates for cloud usage.
criteria.evidence: TOTAL FIXED PRICE (excl. GST) 3,957,450... Payment schedule: 20% on award | 20% Phase 1 | 25% Phase 2 UAT | 25% Phase 3 audit | 10% final acceptance... Cloud consumption (AWS/Azure) is pass-through at list price — estimated SGD 18,000–22,000/month post go-live.

criteria.justification: Security controls are comprehensively integrated using a Shift-Left DevSecOps approach, Zero Trust architecture, and 24x7 SOC monitoring. Apex holds active certifications across ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, CMMI Level 5, and PCI-DSS v4.
criteria.evidence: Security is embedded via a DevSecOps (Shift-Left) model... Identity & Access: ZTNA; MFA enforced; PAM for privileged accounts... ISO 27001:2022 CERTIFIED, SOC 2 Type II CERTIFIED, PCI-DSS v4.0 COMPLIANT, MAS TRM Self-Assessment COMPLETED.

criteria.justification: Apex demonstrates deep organizational experience (18 years, 420+ transformation projects) and a well-defined SLA support model with clear response times. However, Section 9 (Relevant Experience & References) cuts off mid-sentence, resulting in incomplete reference details.
criteria.evidence: Completed over 420 large-scale digital transformation programmes... Priority P1 - Critical Initial Response: 15 min (24×7), Resolution: 4 hours... Section 9 text cuts off abruptly: 'Outcome Mega'.

risks: Section 9 of the proposal is truncated, leaving specific client reference case studies and outcome details incomplete.
A significant portion of the core delivery team (22 out of 34 members) is based offshore in Bengaluru, requiring robust cross-border management.
Data migration from 6 legacy on-premise applications presents potential risk of timeline delays if legacy data quality is poor.
suppliers.overall_summary: Apex Systems submitted a compelling, technical, and commercial response that fully addresses every requirement of the EDIM programme. Their solution offers impressive system headroom, comprehensive security controls, clear risk management, and transparent fixed-fee pricing. The only notable deficiency is an incomplete reference section due to document truncation at the end of the response.

criteria.justification: Orbit Digital proposes a mature AWS-hosted platform with multi-AZ deployment, auto-scaling, and visual workflow tools. However, their standard Kafka event streaming capacity is 15,000 TPS, which falls short of the RFP requirement for 50,000 TPS and requires further evaluation in a post-award discovery phase.
criteria.evidence: Integration Layer: REST APIs; webhook; SFTP; Kafka event streaming (capacity: 15,000 TPS)... integration architecture requirements (specifically, real-time event streaming at 50,000 TPS) represent a significant technical scope that will benefit from detailed discovery before architecture is finalised.

criteria.justification: The proposal presents a well-structured 17-week phased implementation plan with clear deliverables, gate reviews, sprint demos, and governance structures. Including a 3-week Architecture Discovery phase early in the project effectively de-risks technical integration.
criteria.evidence: Orbit Digital proposes a 17-week phased delivery with a critical Architecture Discovery phase at the start to confirm integration patterns before development commences.

criteria.justification: Commercial terms are clearly itemized, resulting in a Year 1 fixed total of SGD 705,000 (excluding GST and AWS). However, the integration development cost of SGD 70,000 is explicitly stated as an estimate, introducing commercial risk of scope changes and price adjustments post-discovery.
criteria.evidence: TOTAL YEAR 1 (excl. GST, excl. AWS): FIXED 705,000... NOTE: Integration cost (SGD 70,000) is an estimate pending Architecture Discovery. Final integration cost will be confirmed and agreed before Phase 2 commences via a formal change order.

criteria.justification: The response demonstrates strong security controls, featuring ISO 27001:2013 certification, AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit, MAS TRM gap assessments, Singapore data residency for PDPA compliance, and defined DR SLAs (RPO ≤ 15 min, RTO ≤ 45 min).
criteria.evidence: Orbit Digital holds current ISO 27001:2013 certification, scoped to system development and managed services... MAS TRM: Gap assessment included in scope; remediation roadmap provided.

criteria.justification: Orbit Digital demonstrates extensive regional track record with 310+ delivered projects and high-profile enterprise references in financial services and logistics. Their support framework is operating 24x7 across Singapore and KL with strict P1 response (30 mins) and resolution (4 hours) SLAs.
criteria.evidence: Orbit Digital operates a 24×7 support centre from Singapore and Kuala Lumpur... P1 – Critical: Response 30 min (24×7); Resolution 4 hours... OCBC Bank (SG): Vendor management system; 8 integrations; 600 users; MAS TRM compliant.

risks: Standard platform Kafka streaming capability (15,000 TPS) is below the requested 50,000 TPS throughput requirement, introducing potential technical scope risks.
The SGD 70,000 integration pricing is an estimate that may trigger cost increases via change orders following the Architecture Discovery phase.
suppliers.overall_summary: Orbit Digital delivers a strong, highly credible RFP submission backed by relevant financial sector references, solid security standards, and a structured 17-week delivery approach. Primary evaluation risks focus on technical throughput limitations (15,000 TPS standard vs. 50,000 TPS required) and associated potential cost growth via change orders after the initial Architecture Discovery phase.

criteria.justification: The proposal presents a standard three-tier cloud architecture on AWS using containerised services. However, base scope includes limitations such as Single-AZ database deployment, basic monitoring without distributed tracing, read-only scheduled ERP integration, and exclusion of real-time event streaming or SCIM 2.0 provisioning.
criteria.evidence: PostgreSQL 14 (AWS RDS Single-AZ); LIMITATION: Real-time bidirectional integration, event-driven messaging, and sub-second data synchronisation are not included in the base proposal.

criteria.justification: Provides a structured 10-week timeline across clearly defined phases and milestones with a named 6-person delivery team. However, detailed risk planning is deferred until after project initiation, and key roles such as Security Specialist, Compliance Lead, and Change Management Lead are omitted from the scope.
criteria.evidence: BrightPath proposes an accelerated 10-week delivery from kick-off to go-live... Detailed milestone risk planning will be finalised after project initiation... BrightPath does not propose a dedicated Security Specialist, Compliance Lead, or Change Management Lead within this scope.

criteria.justification: Extremely clear, transparent line-item pricing breakdown totalling AUD 408,727 (~SGD 360,000) for Year 1, with explicit payment milestones and currency conversions. Minor risk remains due to additional costs for custom API connectors and single-AZ/multi-AZ upgrades.
criteria.evidence: TOTAL YEAR 1 (excl. GST) 408,727 (~ SGD 360,000)... Payment: 50% on kick-off, 30% on UAT sign-off, 20% on go-live.

criteria.justification: While basic technical controls (AES-256 encryption, TLS 1.2+, Auth0, audit logging, daily backups) are outlined, the supplier lacks key security certifications (ISO 27001, SOC 2) and excludes MAS TRM compliance, PDPA audits, and penetration testing from the base proposal.
criteria.evidence: formal ISO 27001, SOC 2, or PCI-DSS certifications are not currently held. MAS TRM compliance assessment is out of scope for base proposal... Formal pen-test, MAS TRM compliance assessment, PDPA audit, SOC 2 — NOT INCLUDED in base scope

criteria.justification: Strong track record of 80+ software delivery projects with two relevant enterprise references provided. Support coverage is limited strictly to business hours with no 24x7 option included in the standard proposal.
criteria.evidence: BrightPath has delivered 80+ software projects... FreshMart Retail Group (AU) ... Coastal Freight Pty Ltd (AU)... Support channel: email ticketing system (Freshdesk). No 24×7 or weekend support in base scope.

risks: Compliance and security gaps due to deferral of MAS TRM compliance, PDPA audits, SOC 2 certification, and penetration testing post-go-live.
Lack of 24x7 support coverage (business-hours support only), which could lead to extended downtime during critical off-hours incidents.
Scope creep and additional costs post-discovery for requirements like real-time integrations, multi-AZ database setup, and custom connectors.
suppliers.overall_summary: BrightPath Tech offers an aggressive 10-week implementation timeline and transparent pricing for an SME-focused modern web application delivery. However, the proposal carries notable technical and compliance limitations, including Single-AZ infrastructure, missing security certifications, and the exclusion of MAS TRM, PDPA, and pen-testing from the core scope. While suitable for cost-conscious, lower-complexity projects, critical enterprise capabilities and security assurance are deferred as add-ons.
